_readme: Pretest bug key remap. The Facets/PCTS workbooks keep the ticket that was raised at the time; when a different ticket is now what blocks those test cases, map old -> new here. build_pretest.py applies it to every case and to the BugList, so it survives a new workbook upload.

NR1LT-6874.note: NR1LT-7899 (STR unavailable) is what blocks the test cases originally tagged NR1LT-6874
